order_book: Now, as I see from last year, our March closing order book was roughly around INR240 crores and our fleet size was 425 equipment.
Now this year our equipment has become 545, but our order book is still around INR248 crores.
guidance: In financial year FY27, we are target ing revenue growth of about 25 % to 30%, and our full focus will also be on maintaining healthy operational margins.
capex: So there is, in other current liabilities, as we have elaborated, there is around INR120 crores capex purchase creditors.
risks: Do you feel a bit of a slowdown or what do you feel, sir?
ADB funded means Asia n Development Bank funded projects, in those the payment is very smooth, there is no delay in payment.
focus: The vision of the Indian Government for 2047 is to focus on modern and infrastructural development.
So in mining, we are focusing on iron ore mining, where we are going to do crushing and screening, plus we are adding some tippers, which is the world's most premium brand.

So we are focusing on that and some opportunities are also coming up, so somewhere within this year, we will have an entry into that and the focus will only be on iron ore mining - I mean, iron ore mining equipment.
